name: DLT-20A blaster rifle
description: The DLT-20A blaster rifle, also known as the DLT-20A laser rifle, was a model of blaster rifle and longblaster produced by BlasTech Industries. It was equipped with several operational modes, including a rapid-fire option and sniper rifle capabilities. The DLT-20A saw usage by several groups throughout its history, including the Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, and outlaws.
